Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. One establishment retained, the value moving from 0 to 1: the Lisbon School of Education (ESELx), part of the Lisbon Polytechnic, a public institution. Criterion read at source: a postgraduate course in Puppetry and Animated Forms, 60 ECTS over two semesters, taught on site. Puppetry is the object of the training itself. Qualification caveat on record: this is a postgraduate course rather than a bachelor's or master's degree, making it a degree-granting higher education course but in a shorter format than those counted elsewhere in the series. Since the denominator sets no floor beyond being higher education and degree-granting, it is retained. Upper bound held at 1: the page read states the course is unique in Portugal's advanced training landscape and the country's only entry in the world directory of schools in the field. Read, not inferred.
